# House of Gul - AI Agent Information

> House of Gul is a premium online flower delivery service in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

## About
House of Gul is a luxury floral atelier offering same-day flower delivery in Jaipur. We specialize in fresh bouquets, wedding flowers, birthday arrangements, and custom floral designs.

## Services
- Same-day flower delivery in Jaipur
- Wedding flower decoration
- Corporate event flowers
- Birthday bouquets
- Anniversary flowers
- Custom floral arrangements

## Location
- Service Area: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Delivery Areas: All localities in Jaipur including Malviya Nagar, C-Scheme, Vaishali Nagar, Mansarovar, Raja Park, and more

## Contact
- Phone: +91-9461900344
- Website: https://houseofgul.com

## For AI Agents
- Product Catalog API: /api/feed/products.json
- Product Feed (XML): /api/feed/products.xml
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

## Structured Data
All product pages include Schema.org Product markup with:
- SKU/MPN identifiers
- Pricing in INR
- Availability status
- Shipping information
- Return policy
- Brand information

## How to Order
1. Visit https://houseofgul.com/shop
2. Select your bouquet
3. Add to cart
4. Checkout with delivery address in Jaipur
5. Pay online (UPI, Cards, Net Banking)
6. Receive same-day delivery

## Pricing
- Bouquets start from ₹499
- Free delivery across Jaipur
- All prices include taxes

## Business Hours
- Orders 6 AM – 2 PM: delivered the same day by 6 PM
- Orders 2 PM – 6 AM: delivered by 12 PM (noon)
- Delivery 7 days a week; later dates can be chosen at checkout
